title: Python 3 abstract syntax tree (with comments) as JSON
description: A Python module as produced by pyast_json.source_to_json(): every node is an object whose '_type' is the name of its class in Python's ast module (grammar of Python 3.9 to 3.15). Statements may carry 'comments'. Positions and type comments are not stored.

FunctionDef.description: ast.FunctionDef(identifier name, arguments args, stmt* body, expr* decorator_list, expr? returns, type_param* type_params)

AsyncFunctionDef.description: ast.AsyncFunctionDef(identifier name, arguments args, stmt* body, expr* decorator_list, expr? returns, type_param* type_params)

ClassDef.description: ast.ClassDef(identifier name, expr* bases, keyword* keywords, stmt* body, expr* decorator_list, type_param* type_params)

TypeAlias.description: ast.TypeAlias(expr name, type_param* type_params, expr value)

AugAssign.description: ast.AugAssign(expr target, operator op, expr value)

AnnAssign.description: ast.AnnAssign(expr target, expr annotation, expr? value, flag simple)

For.description: ast.For(expr target, expr iter, stmt* body, stmt* orelse)

AsyncFor.description: ast.AsyncFor(expr target, expr iter, stmt* body, stmt* orelse)

While.description: ast.While(expr test, stmt* body, stmt* orelse)

If.description: ast.If(expr test, stmt* body, stmt* orelse)

Try.description: ast.Try(stmt* body, excepthandler* handlers, stmt* orelse, stmt* finalbody)

TryStar.description: ast.TryStar(stmt* body, excepthandler* handlers, stmt* orelse, stmt* finalbody)

ImportFrom.description: ast.ImportFrom(identifier? module, alias* names, count? level, flag? is_lazy)

BinOp.description: ast.BinOp(expr left, operator op, expr right)

IfExp.description: ast.IfExp(expr test, expr body, expr orelse)

DictComp.description: ast.DictComp(expr key, expr? value, comprehension* generators)

Compare.description: ast.Compare(expr left, cmpop* ops, expr* comparators)

Call.description: ast.Call(expr func, expr* args, keyword* keywords)

FormattedValue.description: ast.FormattedValue(expr value, conversion conversion, JoinedStr? format_spec)

Interpolation.description: ast.Interpolation(expr value, string str, conversion conversion, JoinedStr? format_spec)

Attribute.description: ast.Attribute(expr value, identifier attr, expr_context ctx)

Subscript.description: ast.Subscript(expr value, expr slice, expr_context ctx)

Slice.description: ast.Slice(expr? lower, expr? upper, expr? step)

ExceptHandler.description: ast.ExceptHandler(expr? type, identifier? name, stmt* body)

MatchMapping.description: ast.MatchMapping(expr* keys, pattern* patterns, identifier? rest)

MatchClass.description: ast.MatchClass(expr cls, pattern* patterns, identifier* kwd_attrs, pattern* kwd_patterns)

TypeVar.description: ast.TypeVar(identifier name, expr? bound, expr? default_value)

comprehension.description: ast.comprehension(expr target, expr iter, expr* ifs, flag is_async)

arguments.description: ast.arguments(arg* posonlyargs, arg* args, arg? vararg, arg* kwonlyargs, expr?* kw_defaults, arg? kwarg, expr* defaults)

match_case.description: ast.match_case(pattern pattern, expr? guard, stmt* body)

flag.description: Boolean stored as an int, as in the ast module.

comments.description: Comment texts without the leading '#', one per line.

real.description: A float: a JSON number, or one of the non-finite values as a string.

constant_complex.description: A complex constant (the parser only produces imaginary literals).

constant_bytes.description: A bytes constant; character U+00XX stands for byte 0xXX.

constant_str_escaped.description: A string containing lone surrogates (which JSON strings cannot hold faithfully), in Python's 'unicode_escape' encoding.

Constant_str.description: A Constant whose value is a string (literal part of an f/t-string).
